notes: REMOVED from the public API in v0.4 -- absent from metrics.collections, reachable only through a deprecation shim, migration guide says 'AspectCritic - Removed'. Recorded because the legacy path still runs and the shipped 'correctness' definition is a bare self-solve. Note the shipped typo 'criterial', useful as a lineage fingerprint.

C1_de_anchoring.evidence: Single call. Template: 'Evaluate the Input based on the criterial defined. Use only Yes (1) and No (0) as verdict. Criteria Definition: {definition}'. With the shipped correctness definition -- 'Is the submission factually accurate and free from errors?' -- the judge must determine the truth itself, but it emits only Yes/No: no parseable answer of its own is produced, and acceptance is that holistic verdict rather than a match against a committed answer.
C1_de_anchoring.reasoning: recompute_variant set on an implicit rather than explicit instruction: there is no 'solve it first' wording, but the criterion cannot be answered without the judge forming its own view, and it is never required to commit that view in parseable form. Flagged as a judgement call.

C2_ground_truth_channel.evidence: All AspectCriticInput fields are Optional and default None; documented default is reference-free.
C2_ground_truth_channel.reasoning: Scored fail even where a reference is supplied. A reference handed to the judge improves the judge -- agreement rises from 0.34-0.74 to 0.85-0.96 (arXiv:2607.12885) -- but it does not create a second instrument. There is still exactly one thing producing the verdict and nothing that could observe it failing. Recorded with reference_supplied so the two populations can be reported separately.

C3_retrieval_controls.evidence: The metric scores a supplied string. The environment that produced the candidate is outside its scope, so this criterion attaches to the surrounding harness.
C3_retrieval_controls.reasoning: Marked n/a rather than fail throughout this stratum. Penalising a metric for a property of the harness around it would inflate the failure rate dishonestly.

C4_degenerate_pass_resistance.evidence: Scoring is a single pass over a fixed test case. Nothing in the configuration introduces inputs the candidate cannot enumerate in advance; the judge prompt is public and static.
